contexts.text: Pharaoh... by whom is represented human wisdom or intelligence; that is, knowledge in general; is called a great whale. Illustrated.
Even Pharaoh, who exalted Joseph over Egypt, (represented the Lord's royalty). AC 1361:2.
Pharaoh, or Egypt = sci entities.
The princes of Pharaoh saw her () = the primary precepts.
That the knowledge signified by Pharaoh did well to... the Lord when a boy. Signified.
Jehovah smote Pharaoh with great plagues () = that the scientifics were destroyed; for Pharaoh = knowledge in general, and therefore the scientifics which are of knowledge. (Explained see Know.)

Pharaoh called Abram () = that the Lord remembered; (for) Pharaoh = knowledge. Knowledge itself, or the scientifics themselves, which the Lord imbibed when a boy, are here called Pharaoh. Thus it is knowledge itself which thus addresses the Lord, that is, Jehovah through knowledge.
Pharaoh commanded the men upon him () = that scientifics left the Lord. Pharaoh = knowledge. AC 1547.
Pharaoh = knowledge in general.
Egypt, and Pharaoh = knowledge.

The successive recession of the Church from charity, and its deflection to faith... is represented... finally by Pharaoh and the Egyptians, in that they treated evilly the sons of Israel. -, Explained.
The army of Pharaoh = falsities thence.
Pharaoh = scientifics.
Pharaoh was wroth () = that the new natural man averted itself. Pharaoh, or the king of Egypt = the new natural man, or the new state of the natural man.
The interior Natural is that which is represented by Pharaoh the king of Egypt...
Pharaoh, or the king of Egypt, in () = the new state of the Natural; consequently the interior Natural; for this is made new.
Pharaoh here represents the Lord as to the new state of the Natural, or as to the interior Natural.
Pharaoh's cup in my hand () = the influx of the interior Natural into the exterior, and the beginning of reception.
I gave the cup upon the palm of Pharaoh () = appropriation by the interior Natural. AC 5126.
Cause me to be remembered to Pharaoh () = communication with the interior Natural.

Of all the food of Pharaoh () = full of celestial good for nourishing the Natural. Pharaoh = the interior Natural, and also the Natural in general; for the interior and the exterior Natural make a one when they correspond. AC 5160.
On Pharaoh's birthday () = when the Natural was being regenerated.
Pharaoh (in ) = the Natural in general, which now rested, and left all things to the Celestial of the Spiritual.
Pharaoh dreamed () = what was foreseen concerning the Natural.
Pharaoh awoke () = a state of illustration in the Natural. AC 5218.
Pharaoh sent () = the propensity of the new Natural... to receive the Celestial of the Spiritual. Explained.
(Joseph) came to Pharaoh () = communication with the new Natural.
Pharaoh said to Joseph () = the perception of the Celestial of the Spiritual from the Natural... (for) the Lord is represented by both Joseph and Pharaoh... by Pharaoh, as to the Natural.
What God doeth He hath told to Pharaoh () = that it was given to the Natural to apperceive what was provided.
This is the word which I have spoken to Pharaoh () = that which the Natural thought from the Celestial of the Spiritual.
He hath made Pharaoh see () = the apperception of the Natural.
Upon the dream being repeated to Pharaoh two times () = because it was foreseen concerning both Naturals.
Now let Pharaoh see () = the looking forward of the Natural. Explained.
Under the hand of Pharaoh () = for necessity and consequent disposition in the Natural.
The word was good in the eyes of Pharaoh () = the complacency of the Natural.
Pharaoh said to his servants () = the perception of the Natural with all things there.
Pharaoh said to Joseph () = the perception of the Natural from the Celestial of the Spiritual. AC 5315. AC 5325. AC 5937.
Pharaoh removed his ring from upon his hand () = ... that the Natural abdicated the power which it before had...
I am Pharaoh () = that... the Natural is from the Celestial of the Spiritual. Explained.

In his standing before Pharaoh king of Egypt () = when his presence was in the Natural... Pharaoh king of Egypt = the new state of the Natural, or the new natural man; thus the Natural in which now was the Celestial of the Spiritual; and which the Celestial of the Spiritual now has made its own.
Joseph went forth from before Pharaoh () = when the Natural in general was his.
The people cried unto Pharaoh for bread () = the need of good for truth in the Natural.
Pharaoh said to all Egypt () = ... apperception in both Naturals, in general and in particular.
Let Pharaoh live () = what is certain; (for this expression) is a form of asseveration AC 5454.
As thou art, so is Pharaoh () = that the Internal has dominion over the Natural.
The house of Pharaoh heard () = through the universal Natural; (for) Pharaoh = the Natural in general. AC 5933.
He hath set me for a father to Pharaoh () = that now the Natural is from... internal good. This, by influx, ordinates all things in the Natural, and at last causes the Natural to be from itself.
It was good in the eyes of Pharaoh () = joy everywhere in... the Natural in general.
Pharaoh = the Scientific of the Natural in general.
Pharaoh = the Scientific of the Church in general; for Egypt = the Scientific of the Church; and therefore its king = this Scientific in general. Illustrated.
I will go up and tell Pharaoh () = communication with the Natural where are the scientifics of the Church.
It may be that Pharaoh will call you () = if the Natural in which are the scientifics of the Church is willing to be conjoined.
The Scientific into which these truths are insinuated, is Pharaoh (in ).
Joseph came, and told Pharaoh () = the presence of the Celestial Internal in the Natural, where scientifics are, and thence influx... Pharaoh = the Natural, and thence the Scientific in general.
Set them before Pharaoh () = insinuation into scientifics. Pharaoh = the Scientific in general.
Pharaoh said unto (Joseph's) brethren () = perception concerning the truths of the Church in the Natural. Pharaoh = the Natural and the Scientific in general.
Pharaoh said to Joseph () = perception in the Natural where scientifics are.
Pharaoh said to Jacob () = perception in the Natural where scientifics are concerning the general truth of the Church.
Jacob blessed Pharaoh = a devout wish for conjunction, and consequent fructification. And went out from before Pharaoh () = separation as to time... from the Natural where scientifics are.
Joseph brought the silver into the house of Pharaoh () = that it was all referred to the General in the Natural.
We and our ground will be servants to Pharaoh () = total submission... to the Natural in general, which is under the auspices of the Celestial Internal. AC 6138:end.

Joseph bought all the ground of Egypt for Pharaoh () = that he appropriated to himself the whole natural mind where scientifics are, and placed it under the general auspices in the Natural. AC 6142:end.
The land was Pharaoh's () = that all things were subjected to the Natural which was under the auspices of the Internal.
A part was assigned to the priests by Pharaoh () = that therefore it was ordinated by the Natural, which was under the auspices of the Internal.
Which Pharaoh gave them (): according to ordination... in the Natural (which was) under the auspices of the Internal.
I have bought you... and your ground for Pharaoh () = that he procured these things for himself, and subjected them to the General in the Natural, which was under the auspices of the Internal.
Ye shall give the fifth part to Pharaoh () = remains, that these are for the General which is under the auspices of the Internal.
Ae will be servants to Pharaoh () = that they abdicate what is their Own, and submit it to the Natural which is under the auspices of the Internal.
By Pharaoh is represented the Natural, but not as to truths, but as to scientifics... into which truths can be initiated... which is represented by the coming of Jacob and his sons into Egypt.
Joseph spake to the house of Pharaoh () = the influx of the Internal into the natural mind.
All the servants of Pharaoh went up with him () = that he adjoined himself to the scientifics of the Natural. (For) Pharaoh = the Natural in general.

Pharaoh, who is here the king = the Scientific in general... (here) the false Scientific, that is, the Scientific which is against the truths of the Church. Hence he is called a new king; for he who was in the time of Joseph represented the Scientific which is in accord with the truths of the Church.
They built store-cities for Pharaoh () = doctrines from falsified truths in the Natural where are alienated scientifics.
The midwives said to Pharaoh () = apperception concerning these scientific truths in the Natural... Pharaoh = false scientifics in general.

Pharaoh commanded all the people () = a general influx into the scientifics contrary to the truths of the Church... A general influx, because from Pharaoh, by whom is represented the Scientific in general.
Pharaoh () = the Natural where is the Scientific. References.

The daughter of Pharaoh went down () = what is religious there... Here, what is religious from false scientifics, because she was the daughter of Pharaoh, by whom is here represented the false Scientific. (See also AC 6739. AC 6745. AC 6750.)
Pharaoh heard this word, and sought to kill Moses () = that the false Scientific, on apperceiving this, wanted to destroy the Truth...
Go, I will send thee to Pharaoh () = the Holy proceeding... by which the infesting falsities would be dissipated... Pharaoh = falsity.
Who am I that I should go unto Pharaoh? () = that he was not yet in such a state as to seem to himself able to go and remove the infesting falsities.

These are the things which are represented by Pharaoh, in that he so often set himself in opposition; and the removal of such Spirits, and their detrusion into Hell, is represented by the destruction of Pharaoh and the Egyptians in the Sea Suph.
Do (these portents) before Pharaoh () = against the infesting falsities.
Say to Pharaoh () = exhortation (to) the falsity which is infesting the truths of the Church... AC 7090.
Pharaoh said () = contrary thought... by those who are infesting.

Pharaoh represented those in the Hells who are in falsities, and infest those of the Spiritual Church; being mostly such as have said that faith alone saves, and yet have lived a life contrary to faith. (Their state in the Spiritual World described.). AC 7317.
Pharaoh said () = the will of those who infest the truths of the Church. AC 7110.
They cried to Pharaoh () = indignation displayed before those who were infesting.
Pharaoh = falsity infesting. References. AC 7167.
Pharaoh = those who infest by means of injected falsities. References. AC 7224.
Pharaoh, when called also the king of Egypt, = those who infest by mere falsities. AC 7237. AC 7243. AC 8142.
I have given thee a god to Pharaoh () = the power of the Law Divine over those in falsities.
I will harden Pharaoh's heart () = obstinacy from the evil of falsity.
Pharaoh will not listen to you () = that those in falsities will not receive.
Pharaoh = those who are in falsities and infest. AC 7390. AC 7396. AC 7397. AC 7429.
Pharaoh and his servants = those who infest by falsities.

Pharaoh, of whom it is here said that he listened not represents those who are in falsities and infest; and, so far as they infest, so far they are in evil from falsities; for infestation is from evil, and is effected through falsities.
Pharaoh = those who infest by means of falsities. AC 7348.
The house of Pharaoh = falsity; for, when Pharaoh represents falsity, so also does his house.
The servants, and people, of Pharaoh = all things which are in the Natural... AC 7441. AC 7448.
All and each who were in the land of Egypt are meant by Pharaoh, his people, and his servants; thus falsities in all and each.
This is why Pharaoh deprecated the evil of the frog...
Pharaoh () ... those who infest by means of reasonings from mere falsities.
Pharaoh () = those who are in evils, because they are now in a state of evil, after reasoning falsities have been taken away. AC 7436.
This was represented by Pharaoh, in that when Moses was present he humbled himself, and made promise... but when Moses went out, he hardened his heart.
Pharaoh... those who infest in the other life those of the Spiritual Church. References. AC 7513. AC 7527. AC 7538. AC 7631, References. AC 7650. AC 7670.
As Pharaoh = the Natural in general, his servants the things in the natural mind. Explained.
The servants of Pharaoh () = those of a lower sort who infest, and who are in fear.
Pharaoh ()... those who have infested; here, are being damned. AC 7766:end. AC 7791. AC 7794.
Pharaoh... the primary ones who have infested, under whom the rest are subordinated.
Pharaoh... the Scientific in general perverting the truths of the Church. References. Thus the first-born of Pharaoh () ... the faith of such; consequently, a faith of the falsified truths of faith.

Pharaoh arose in that night, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians () ... that all and each of the damned, when they were let into mere falsity from evil, apperceived aversion and fear for those of the Spiritual Church.
Pharaoh... those who have infested by means of falsities. References.
In Pharaoh's sending the people away () ... then those who had infested were leaving those of the Spiritual Church.
Pharaoh will say concerning the sons of Israel () ... the thought of those who are in damnation concerning the state of those of the Spiritual Church.
Pharaoh = those in falsities from evil; or, what is the same, those in damnation. AC 8142. AC 8143.
In Pharaoh, and in all his army () ... the immersion in Hell of those who are in falsities from evil.
Pharaoh... the falsities which are of separated faith; for those in faith separated from charity, and at the same time in a life of evil, cannot but be in falsities.
The falsities which are here signified by Pharaoh, his army, and people ... are chiefly the falsities of those who are in persuasive faith. Explained.
Pharaoh drew nigh () = a grievous influx of falsity from evil.
I will be glorified in Pharaoh... ()... the effect of the dissipation of falsity... from the Divine good of the Lord's Human. Explained.
The horses of Pharaoh... () = scientifics from a perverted Intellectual...

The chariots of Pharaoh, and his army, He hath cast into the sea () = the falsities from evil in special, and in general, of those who are of the Church, and are in a life of evil there: that at His presence they have cast themselves into Hell.
Pharaoh and the Egyptians = those in faith separated from charity and in a life of evil.
He hath delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh () deliverance from the falsity of those who have infested.
Pharaoh = those who by means of falsities infest the upright in the other life. References.
All that Jehovah had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians ()... the power of the Lord's Divine Human against those who have been in falsities and have infested.
Pharaoh king of Egypt () ... the scientifics which pervert and destroy the truths and goods of faith. References.
Pharaoh king of Egypt ()... the natural man. ( = the Scientific which is of the natural man. AE 388:28.) ( = the natural man and the Scientific there. AE 513:5.)
Pharaoh and his army () = those who are in falsities from evil.
The house of Pharaoh () ... the natural man as to the scientifics there.

So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who confide upon him ... () = that such is the natural man separate from the spiritual as to his scientifics and derivative intelligence, and the reasoning from this.
As Pharaoh king of Egypt ()... the Intellectual of the natural man, which is born and formed from scientific truths rationally seen, he is here called Asshur...
Pharaoh = the like as Egypt, namely, the natural man as to knowledge and the derivative intelligence.
Pharaoh king of Egypt ()... the knowledge of the natural man and the derivative Own intelligence. AE 654:59. ( = the natural and sensuous man. AE 714:28.)
Afterwards is described the natural man such as he is when separated from the spiritual, by Pharaoh, in that he made the sons of Israel to serve grievously...
Pharaoh and the Egyptians () = the natural man obsessed by evils and falsities of every kind; and the affectation of dominion of the natural man over the spiritual.
